name: glsl-function-vec4-input-w
purpose: Verify that an unlinked GLSL Function vec4 input preserves the fourth vector component during Eevee material evaluation.
passCriteria: A GLSL Function receives a vec4 input with w=0.0, maps color.w to RGB, renders a plane in Eevee, and the center pixel RGB channels stay below 0.05.
original: GLSL Function vec4 input w release regression
